title: 240813_155556_FR_Tourists_and_church_bells_in_Riquewihr by kevp888
author: kevp888
sourceDescription: Tourists, fountain, and church bells in Riquewihr, France. I made this recording during a nice summer day, on the top of the famous traditional village named Riquewihr, located in the east of France. One can hear tourists chatting and rambling, with the sound of a fountain in the background, and at #1:39, the bells of the nearby museum ringing for 4PM. Recorded in August 2024 with a Zoom H6essential (built-in XY microphones). Fade in/out applied in Audacity.
